map.先改环比转化率最低、且流量最大的环节，边际收益最高；别一上来动顶部大流量低转化的: Start with the step that has the lowest period-on-period conversion and the largest traffic, since that gives the highest marginal gain; do not start at the top with high traffic and low conversion.
